name: A Wild Raid
flavor: Dangerous beings have poured forth from a nearby hideout. These are not opportunistic raiders, they are veterans of countless battles, and they have come to crush this settlement with overwhelming force.

interactions.history_event: ::name has shattered the onslaught on ::settlement and driven the attackers back!
interactions.announcement: The onslaught on ::settlement has been stopped!

history_events.begin: Dangerous beings from a nearby hideout have unleashed a devastating onslaught on ::settlement.
history_events.end: The onslaught on ::settlement has been stopped. The attackers were driven back to their hideout.
